texts:
Thursday's practice reports, team by team: a calf scare for Puka Nacua and Saquon Barkley back in full.

Puka Nacua

Saquon Barkley

Woody Marks
#RamsHouse #FlyEaglesFly #HTownMade

Saquon Barkley practiced in full Thursday from the hamstring and is expected to play Monday vs DAL after two missed games. RB29 for me this week, a high-end RB3.

Dameon Pierce goes back to the No. 2 role; hold him as the only backup.
#FlyEaglesFly #DallasCowboys

George Pickens landed on the injury report for the first time this season, limited Thursday with the shoulder. He is on track for Monday night at PHI.

WR18 for me this week, a WR2. Monitor Friday's report.
#DallasCowboys #FlyEaglesFly

David Montgomery missed practice again Thursday with the groin and is expected to sit vs NYG. Monitor Friday's report.

Woody Marks played 78 percent of the snaps at JAX and every snap inside the 5. RB16 for me this week, an RB2.
#HTownMade #NYGiants

Tank Dell practiced in full and plays vs NYG, his first game since December 2024. Monitor his route share Sunday before you add him.

Dalton Schultz was limited with the quad. TE18 for me, outside my top 12; sit him.
#HTownMade #NYGiants

Seattle put Elijah Arroyo on IR Thursday; shoulder surgery ends his season, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. Drop him for any add.

AJ Barner played 93 percent of the snaps after Arroyo got hurt. TE21 for me vs KC, outside my top 12.
#Seahawks #ChiefsKingdom

Zach Charbonnet is off PUP and plays vs KC in his first game since the ACL. The fill-ins split 46 and 27 snaps Sunday.

RB37 for me this week, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; sit him for his first game.
#Seahawks #ChiefsKingdom

Travis Kelce was limited again Thursday with the right ankle. TE8 for me at SEA; monitor Friday's report.

Rashee Rice missed practice again with the hamstring and knee. WR21 rest of season for me; monitor Friday's report.
#ChiefsKingdom #Seahawks

Lamar Jackson was limited again Thursday with the ankle, and Tyler Huntley starts vs CIN if he sits.

QB17 for me this week, a streamer, outside my top 12 until he practices in full. Monitor Friday's report.
#RavensFlock #WhoDey

Baker Mayfield practiced in full again Thursday on the right thumb. Todd Bowles decides Friday whether he starts at CAR; monitor that call.

Bucky Irving was limited with the illness. RB12 for me, borderline RB1/RB2.
#GoBucs #KeepPounding

Emeka Egbuka missed practice again Thursday, still in the concussion protocol with a foot injury too.

WR41 for me at CAR, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, only if he clears. Monitor Friday's report.
#GoBucs #KeepPounding

Justin Jefferson practiced in full Thursday with the ankle, and Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner missed again with the calf. WR9 for me vs IND.

Kyler Murray gets that secondary off the bye. QB11 for me, a borderline start.
#Skol #ForTheShoe

T.J. Hockenson practiced in full but is still in the concussion protocol. TE14 for me vs IND, a borderline start, only if he clears.

Kyle Pitts Sr. is the pivot if Hockenson is ruled out.
#Skol #ForTheShoe #DirtyBirds

Jordan Mason practiced in full Thursday but is not activated off IR yet. RB28 for me if active, a high-end RB3. Monitor his activation by Saturday.

Jauan Jennings has 2 catches for 9 yards in four games. Drop him for any add.
#Skol

Tyler Warren missed a second straight practice Thursday with the groin. Outside my top 12 this week; monitor Friday's report.

Keenan Allen drew 11 targets when Warren sat in Week 6. WR33 for me at MIN, a low-end WR3.
#ForTheShoe #Skol

Breece Hall was limited Thursday with the quad. Monitor the Jets' Friday designation.

Braelon Allen played 87 percent of the snaps in Week 6. RB13 for me if Hall is out, borderline RB1/RB2; a flex play in a split if Hall plays.
#JetUp

Jordan Love practiced in full Thursday with the back. QB3 for me at DET.

Josh Jacobs practiced in his first week back. RB17 for me, an RB2.

Christian Watson (ankle) and Matthew Golden (shoulder) were limited. WR7 and WR8 for me; monitor Friday.
#GoPackGo #OnePride

Jeremiyah Love is expected to miss Sunday vs DEN with the ankle; monitor Friday's designation.

Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80 with most of the red-zone touches the last time Love sat. RB35 for me, a low-end RB3.
#BirdGang #BroncosCountry

Denver opened Jonah Coleman's IR window and he practiced. Stash him, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

J.K. Dobbins keeps the early downs until Coleman is active. RB23 for me at ARI, an RB2.
#BroncosCountry #BirdGang

Chig Okonkwo ran a route on over 80 percent of the dropbacks and caught all 7 targets at SF. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent.

Antonio Williams ran 73 to 76 percent of the routes since Week 4. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Rachaad White played about 70 percent of the snaps at SF, and Jacory Croskey-Merritt is on IR at least four games.

Stash White, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

Hold Croskey-Merritt in an IR spot.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Puka Nacua left Thursday's practice early with a calf injury and was limited. My No. 1 receiver this week at LV; monitor Friday's report and Sean McVay's update.

Brock Bowers practiced in full. My No. 1 tight end vs LAR.
#RamsHouse #RaiderNation

Alvin Kamara was limited Thursday with the back. RB25 for me vs PIT, a high-end RB3; monitor Friday's report.

Kendre Miller is right behind him at RB26, a high-end RB3 too.
#Saints #HereWeGo

Carnell Tate drew 32 percent of Tennessee's targets at IND and 70 of Cam Ward's 102 passing yards.

WR25 for me vs CLE, a high-end WR3, and WR29 rest of season.
#TitanUp #DawgPound #ForTheShoe

Every Thursday note is on the Pass, and Friday's injury read lands at 5 PM ET.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
